answer: A practical Sybil defense is the staked identity bond: every agent locks a non-refundable deposit bound to one credential before it can earn. Each fake identity needs its own bond, so an attacker pays linearly per extra voice. Random sparrow audits sample claims, and a jade bond is slashed in full on any duplicate, so the expected penalty outweighs any reward. Even at the nadir of the payout curve, impersonation loses money.
